The Friction of Reality vs. The Illusion of Optimal Design
item.description: City simulation games highlight the tension between centralized planning and bureaucratic reality. While engineers and mayors might dream of optimal, top-down solutions, real-world urban development is inherently messy, constrained by public input, unpredictable regulations, and the human friction that video games often gloss over. Quote: Real life is worse than SimCity because of rules and the public getting a say.
